hypothesis: A pre-label, weather-diverse expansion of the sample audit will identify repeatable production Core v3 feature-semantic tensions and yield one bounded continuous challenger specification without using LLM output as a gate.
denominator: All unique production Core-scored checkpoints in 2026-07-24..2026-08-07. Select all policy hits and the existing matched contrast, then expand to 120 cards with at most one additional checkpoint per previously unseen city-day using deterministic coverage of policy bucket, market/residual band, local clock, temperature path, wind, dewpoint depression, time since high, forecast relation, intraday state and precipitation state. Settlement labels are not used for selection.
information_order: LLM receives only PIT METAR observations with report/first-seen clocks, forecast curve and deterministic weather state
production model contributions, market probability, policy role and settlement are attached afterward
structured audit compares relative direction and mechanism semantics; no LLM probability, veto or trade decision is produced

acceptance_gates.mechanism: At least 100 valid cards, zero silent failures, and repeated feature-level tensions across multiple cities and target dates
acceptance_gates.probability: Not tested in this run; any proposed challenger remains research-only until target-date-blocked OOF and frozen forward beat market/Core on the same rows

unique_action: Expand the retrospective sample-level semantic casebook and freeze one continuous market-offset challenger specification.
